_comment: Powers the unlisted /check-in page that the banner QR code points to. The page is not linked anywhere and is marked noindex. Add an entry per event: `date` (and optional `endDate` for multi-day events) are YYYY-MM-DD; an event shows from now until the end of its last day, then drops off by itself. Set `hidden` to true to pull one early. `url` is the event's own check-in form (Google Form, Luma, etc.).
heading: Event Check-In
intro: Welcome! Choose the event you are attending to check in.
